name: govcon-pursuit-brain
description: A wiki-native Claude Skills package for the US Federal capture and proposal lifecycle. Instead of producing flat artifacts, the skills compile and maintain a per-pursuit knowledge wiki — an interlinked graph of entity pages for the customer, competitors, requirements, win themes, risks, and more — and render the familiar proposal artifacts as views over that graph. Built on Andrej Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern. Sibling to the artifact-pipeline package federal-proposal-skills.
